name: year
description: Reference year of the index observation

name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the index observation, from 1 to 4
observations: ABS labels each quarter by its final month (Q1 March

name: region
description: Capital city of the price collection or the national aggregate
observations: Values are the eight capital cities plus Australia; for the CPI, Australia denotes the weighted average of the eight capital cities. Could map to a GCCSA geography directory in the future

name: index_code
description: ABS Consumer Price Index item code identifying the expenditure category
observations: ABS CL_CPI_INDEX code (e.g. 10001 = All groups CPI); identifies the product observation level. For the eight names ABS repeats at two hierarchy levels with identical values, the higher-level (parent) code is used

name: index_name
description: Consumer Price Index item label in the ABS expenditure hierarchy
observations: 124 items from All groups CPI down through the 11 groups, sub-groups and expenditure classes; preserved in ABS hierarchical order

name: serie_id
description: ABS time series identifier of the index-number series
observations: Stable ABS Series ID (A-code) for the index number series of this item and region; unique per item and region (the series key)

name: index_number
description: Original Consumer Price Index level for the item and region relative to the ABS reference base period
observations: Not seasonally adjusted; ABS re-references all series to a common base period

name: percentage_change_period
description: Percentage change in the index from the previous quarter
observations: Computed by Data Basis from the index series; QA-checked against ABS-published quarterly change

name: percentage_change_year
description: Percentage change in the index from the same quarter of the previous year
observations: Computed by Data Basis from the index series
